books_beyond_keeper.text: Books Beyond the Bay. The Blasket Islands, off the tip of the peninsula, gave Irish literature some of its finest memoirs.
Tomás Ó Criomhthain wrote 'An tOileánach', 'The Islandman'. Peig Sayers told her life story. Muiris Ó Súilleabháin wrote 'Fiche Blian ag Fás'.
The islanders left the Blaskets in 1953. The books are what stayed, which is a good reason to write things down.
